fields.name: The Native Brain
fields.description: One category I would create that doesn't exist in normal language apps: ""  This would teach how natives think, not just what they say.  Examples:  A learner hears:  "It's not you, it's me."  They understand the words.  But the native meaning is:  "I don't want to continue this relationship, but I am trying to say it politely."  Another:  "We'll see."  Literal: "We will see."  Native meaning: "Probably no."
